question: Union Government's "PAHAL Scheme" is related to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**LPG Subsidy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** PAHAL scheme** is a government initiative to provide** LPG subsidy** directly to the bank accounts of beneficiaries.
 
• The scheme was launched in** 2015** and has been implemented across the country.
 
• The objective of the scheme is to** reduce wasteful expenditure** and ensure that the **subsidy **reaches the intended beneficiaries.
 
• As of **March 2021**, the scheme has over **30 crore beneficiaries **and has resulted in savings of over Rs.** 1.78 lakh crore. **
 
• The scheme has also helped in** reducing air pollution** by encouraging the use of clean cooking fuel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Girl Scholarship**: The government has launched various scholarship schemes for girls to **promote education and empower them.**
 
• **Medical Subsidy**: The government provides medical subsidies for various treatments and procedures under different schemes like** Ayushman Bharat, Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi, etc. **
 
• **Bathroom Construction: **The **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** aims to provide toilets and sanitation facilities to every household in the country to promote hygiene and reduce open defecation.
